generic_sampling_rules.integer_pk: Sequential from 1; never NULL; unique per table.
generic_sampling_rules.text_short: Random token of 3-12 lowercase letters; 5% chance of a near-variant (case flip, one-char typo) of an existing value; 2% NULL if nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_long: Random sentence of 20-120 chars; 3% NULL if nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.real_positive: Lognormal-ish positive value; 1% chance of boundary value near a listed literal; 1% NULL if nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.real_signed: Normal around 0 with std 5; 1% chance of boundary value; 1% NULL if nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.date_iso: Uniform date in 2013-01-01..2024-12-31 formatted %Y-%m-%d; 1% chance of boundary day near a listed literal; never NULL if NOT NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.datetime_iso: Uniform datetime in 2013-01-01..2024-12-31 formatted %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z; 3% NULL if nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.time_hms: Uniform time formatted %H:%M:%S; 1% NULL if nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.enum_small: Uniform over the listed enum values; 1% NULL if nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.fresh_value_share: 0.05 of text values are fresh (not copied from any parent or pool).

semantic_rules_and_formulas.formula: id > 0
status IN ('active','untracked','inactive','extinct')
category IS NULL OR category IN ('coin','token')
date_added IS NULL OR date_added LIKE '____-__-__T__:__:__.___Z'
date_launched IS NULL OR date_launched LIKE '____-__-__T__:__:__.___Z'
date_launched IS NULL OR date_launched >= date_added
semantic_rules_and_formulas.condition: date_launched IS NOT NULL AND date_added IS NOT NULL

cmc_rank IS NULL OR cmc_rank >= 1
price IS NULL OR price >= 0
open IS NULL OR open >= 0
high IS NULL OR high >= 0
low IS NULL OR low >= 0
close IS NULL OR close >= 0
market_cap IS NULL OR market_cap >= 0
volume_24h IS NULL OR volume_24h >= 0
circulating_supply IS NULL OR circulating_supply >= 0
total_supply IS NULL OR total_supply >= 0
max_supply IS NULL OR max_supply >= 0
num_market_pairs IS NULL OR num_market_pairs >= 0
high IS NULL OR low IS NULL OR high >= low
high IS NULL OR open IS NULL OR high >= open
high IS NULL OR close IS NULL OR high >= close
low IS NULL OR open IS NULL OR low <= open
low IS NULL OR close IS NULL OR low <= close
time_high IS NULL OR time_high LIKE '__:__:__'

supporting_evidence.high_ge_low: historical rows 1-8: high >= low in every shown row (e.g. row1 high=147.488, low=134.0).
supporting_evidence.high_ge_open_close: historical rows 1-8: high >= open and high >= close in every shown row.
supporting_evidence.low_le_open_close: historical rows 1-8: low <= open and low <= close in every shown row.
supporting_evidence.date_launched_ge_date_added: coins rows 1-8: date_launched (2015-2018) >= date_added (2013) in every shown row.
supporting_evidence.nonneg_prices: historical rows 1-8: price, open, high, low, close, market_cap, volume_24h, supplies all >= 0.

uncertainty: No formula ties close to open/price or market_cap to price*supply on the shown rows (row1: price*supply=1.489e9 vs market_cap=1.4886e9 close but not exact; row8: price*supply=1.6037e9 vs market_cap=1.6038e9). No exact formula stated. percent_change bounds are loose heuristics. platform_id values in sample (1027, 1765, ...) look like coin ids, not platform ids; treated as free integer.
